prs.title: fix: propagate SSE stream errors to waiting requests
prs.author: heyhayes
prs.cluster_pick_reason: CI is unknown for both PRs. #2374 has a smaller diff (2 files vs 3), but #2122 is older and — more importantly — takes a more complete approach: it propagates SSE stream errors to waiting requests, so callers receive an error signal instead of hanging indefinitely. #2374 only adds logging on the exception, which improves observability but leaves waiting requests without a response, meaning the core behavior reported in #1401 (errors silently swallowed from the caller's perspective) is not actually fixed.
